description: Emart item name and item detail parsing patterns (production-ready)

input_validity_policy.description: Guard rules to prevent accidental over-classification
rules: A line matched by discount_patterns.json must not be classified as item_detail or item_name.
A line matched by summary_patterns.json must not be classified as item_detail or item_name.
A line matched by noise_patterns.json header patterns must not be classified as item_detail or item_name.
Single-line item patterns must be evaluated before generic item_name fallback.
Text-only lines may be item_name candidates, but only after item_detail, discount, summary, and noise checks fail.

patterns.name: parenthesized_alpha_prefix_name
patterns.description: (J), (JN), (Ph) 같은 괄호 영문 prefix 포함 상품명

notes: 상품번호는 상품명 일부가 아니라 prefix로 보고 제거 가능
괄호 영문 prefix는 normalization 대상이며 raw text는 보존한다
item_name fallback은 detail/discount/summary/noise 패턴 검사 이후에만 적용한다
이마트 기본 상세라인은 code + unit_price + qty + total_price 순서
qty 누락 시 3-token 구조를 qty=1로 보정 가능
* prefix는 normalization 후 코드 필드에서 제거 가능
discount_detail, receipt_discount, total/subtotal 구조와 충돌하면 item_detail로 분류하면 안 된다

single_line_item_patterns.description: 상품명과 상품 상세가 한 줄에 결합된 패턴

patterns.name: name_unit_qty_total_inline
patterns.description: 번호 없는 상품명 + 단가 + 수량 + 금액 결합형

notes: 이 패턴은 일반 item_name보다 우선적으로 검사해야 한다
상품명과 상세 필드가 한 줄에 결합되어 있어 parser 단계에서 함께 추출 가능
할인 라인처럼 마지막 음수 금액이 있는 구조는 single-line item으로 분류하면 안 된다

field_optional_policy.description: Optionality of extracted fields by pattern family
notes: single-line item_detail may not have code
3-token detail structures may not have explicit qty

normalization_hints.name: impute_qty_as_1_for_3_token_detail
normalization_hints.description: code + unit_price + total_price 구조면 qty=1 보정

classification_rules.name: single_line_item_detail_before_item_name
classification_rules.if: line matches any single_line_item_patterns and does not match discount or summary patterns

classification_rules.name: barcode_detail_before_name
classification_rules.if: line starts with barcode-like numeric token and matches detail pattern

classification_rules.name: fallback_text_to_item_name
classification_rules.if: line does not match detail/discount/summary/noise patterns and looks like product text

fallback_rules.condition: line starts with barcode-like token and has 3 or 4 transactional tokens
line contains product-like text and does not match discount/summary/noise pattern groups

collision_avoidance_rules.name: not_discount_line
collision_avoidance_rules.rule: If the line ends with a negative amount or matches emart/discount_patterns.json, it must not be classified as item_detail or item_name.

collision_avoidance_rules.name: not_summary_line
collision_avoidance_rules.rule: If the line matches emart/summary_patterns.json, it must not be classified as item_detail or item_name.

collision_avoidance_rules.name: not_header_line
collision_avoidance_rules.rule: If the line matches emart/noise_patterns.json header patterns, it must not be classified as item_detail or item_name.

semantic_handoff_notes: single-line item structures may already include name_raw in parser output
discount 연결과 최종 item 생성은 semantic interpreter에서 수행한다

forbidden_parser_behaviors.name: do_not_merge_multi_line_item_object
forbidden_parser_behaviors.reason: item_name + item_detail 결합은 semantic 단계에서 수행

forbidden_parser_behaviors.name: do_not_classify_discount_or_summary_lines_as_items
forbidden_parser_behaviors.reason: item, discount, summary 충돌은 parser 단계에서 분리되어야 한다
